{"diagnosis": "Trace shows TRAP: cpu trap asserted on 256-word NOP (ADDI x0,x0,0) memory with FAIL 0xdead instead of fetch progress. Root cause is paired: picorv32.v:679 uses `||` making `instr_trap` always 1 when CATCH_ILLINSN is set, vs expected `&& !{...}`; and picorv32.v:877 decodes `is_alu_reg_imm` as 7'b0010010 vs expected OP-IMM 7'b0010011, so NOP/addi never decodes and keeps `!{...}` true.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -679,1 +679,1 @@
-	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,
+	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,
@@ -877,1 +877,1 @@
-			is_alu_reg_imm               <= mem_rdata_latched[6:0] == 7'b0010010;
+			is_alu_reg_imm               <= mem_rdata_latched[6:0] == 7'b0010011;", "expected": "tohost PASS (no TRAP: cpu trap asserted), fetch alignment + progress, checksum != c2a7a4d6295484feeb9ec1ea9381732b8e39a7ccd1997c7d70f6454da2fb4659"}

diagnosis: Trace shows TRAP: cpu trap asserted on 256-word NOP (ADDI x0,x0,0) memory with FAIL 0xdead instead of fetch progress. Root cause is paired: picorv32.v:679 uses `||` making `instr_trap` always 1 when CATCH_ILLINSN is set, vs expected `&& !{...}`; and picorv32.v:877 decodes `is_alu_reg_imm` as 7'b0010010 vs expected OP-IMM 7'b0010011, so NOP/addi never decodes and keeps `!{...}` true.
expected: tohost PASS (no TRAP: cpu trap asserted), fetch alignment + progress, checksum != c2a7a4d6295484feeb9ec1ea9381732b8e39a7ccd1997c7d70f6454da2fb4659
